written.headline: European banks and fintechs adopt NVIDIA open‑weight models for proprietary AI
written.summary: At GTC Berlin, firms such as Revolut, Starling Bank, Lloyds, NatWest and Santander announced using NVIDIA open‑weight models and accelerated GPUs to build in‑house intelligence, with Revolut’s PRAGMA serving an initial 80 million customers and scaling three‑fold.

written.headline: NVIDIA expands Cosmos platform with new training tools and data factory blueprints
written.summary: NVIDIA added training tools, simulation checkpoints and five cloud‑native data factory blueprints to its Cosmos platform, enabling developers to build multimodal world models. Porsche aims to cut repeat test drives by up to 90% and development time by up to 85% using the new blueprints.

written.headline: NVIDIA DSX platform used to address power bottleneck in AI infrastructure
written.summary: Companies worldwide are adopting NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform to integrate grid, substation and AI factory operations as a single system. The move responds to power being the biggest bottleneck, with over $300 billion in equipment backlogged and more than 200 GW of projects in U.S. interconnection queues.

written.headline: European retailers cut inference costs up to 90% using NVIDIA open models
written.summary: Shopify post‑trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for its Sidekick assistant, achieving 90% lower serving cost and 7× faster responses. Other retailers such as Zooplus, Photoroom and L’Oréal reported accuracy gains and faster pipelines using NVIDIA’s open‑model tools.

written.headline: European firms adopt NVIDIA Earth‑2 models for weather and climate forecasting
written.summary: NVIDIA’s Earth‑2 open AI models are being used by organizations such as AXA, Vaisala Xweather and the University of Manchester to improve regional weather forecasts, cyclone risk analysis and air‑quality modeling across Europe. The StormScope EU model provides short‑term cloud predictions every 10 minutes using satellite data.

written.headline: NVIDIA open models adopted in European public sector projects
written.summary: NVIDIA’s open‑weight AI models are being integrated into European government initiatives, including the European Commission’s AI@EC platform and Poland’s healthcare and employment services, using NVIDIA hardware and software such as DGX BasePOD and Triton Inference Server.

written.headline: Environment Duels benchmark studies LLM co‑evolution through author‑solver interactions
written.summary: The paper introduces Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark where LLMs both create environments with hints and solve them, revealing distinct authoring and solving abilities across nine frontier models. Smaller models learn more from others and produce the hardest environments.

written.headline: Paper proposes PAPAV framework to unify multimodal agents and robots
written.summary: Researchers present a capability-centric framework, PAPAV, defining five functions for multimodal embodied agents that combine reasoning with physical action. Analysis of 64 benchmarks shows evaluation heavily emphasizes the Act function, with Anticipate and Verify rarely assessed.
